svg.title: frust
svg.desc: Pixel-art FRUST wordmark and a measured warm full/fat LTO clean-rebuild comparison: Cargo 4920 milliseconds; frust 145 milliseconds; 33.9 times faster. Median of 7 runs on Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 255H, Linux 7.0.0-42-generic x86_64, ext4, rustc 1.97.1. The profile uses fat LTO, one codegen unit and panic abort. Both tools produced byte-identical executables; animated fill durations use the measured timing ratio.
svg.text: shared cache / central targets / queued locks / clean UI
